comment: simctl boot: a simulator booted outside junkfather stays booted after the session ends. Deny cases name why (`says`) and the wrapped form the message shows (`run`); allow cases are other simctl subcommands and boots junkfather owns. junkfather is installed in these cases; without it every command passes.

deny.name: bare boot
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down
deny.run: junkfather own --kind simulator --label "<what it is for>" -- xcrun simctl boot 8A1F0C2E-1111-4222-8333-944455556666

deny.name: boot by name in a chain
deny.command: xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 17 Pro" && xcrun simctl install booted App.app
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: boot after a semicolon
deny.command: xcrun simctl shutdown all; xcrun simctl boot $UDID
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: boot with xcrun options
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: bootstatus -b boots
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: inside sh -c
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: inside a command substitution
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: simctl by path
deny.says: boots a simulator nothing shuts down

deny.name: junkfather own without the simulator kind
deny.run: junkfather own --kind simulator --label "<what it is for>" -- xcrun simctl boot $UDID`

deny.name: junkfather own without the kind around sh -c

allow.name: owned boot
allow.command: junkfather own --kind simulator -- xcrun simctl boot $UDID

allow.name: owned boot with ttl and label
allow.command: junkfather own --kind simulator --ttl 2h --label "ui check" -- xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 17 Pro" && xcrun simctl install booted App.app

allow.name: launch and screenshot
allow.command: xcrun simctl launch booted com.example.app && xcrun simctl io booted screenshot shot.png

allow.name: text that mentions a boot
allow.command: echo 'run xcrun simctl boot under junkfather'
